Subject: Post-call recap & draft action plan — QuantaHealth / pricing ask

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the attached draft action plan (QuantaHealth_ActionPlan_v1.xlsx) so we have a single source of truth as we move toward procurement. High-level from my side:

- Goal: Production inference for Q3 pilot (internal users) with potential expansion to customer-facing features in Q4.
- Target close: prefer a firm commitment by 2026-06-30 to hit Q3 onboarding cadence.
- Proposed commercial baseline: $200k committed annual spend (reserved capacity) with a canonical bundle we discussed (hosted inference + dedicated throughput).

Key milestones in the attached draft (owners suggested in parens):
1) Security questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts (Quanta — Sarah) — dependency: legal review, target 2026-05-21
2) Technical POC (Redwood infra + Quanta test data) (Priyom) — target 2026-06-07
3) Contracting & procurement (Quanta legal + Redwood sales) (Ben) — target 2026-06-21
4) Executive commercial signoff & commit (Quanta exec + Redwood exec) — target 2026-06-30

Pricing ask / executive decision needed: based on today’s signals, we are requesting an executive pricing exception to offer an onboarding credit and an introductory discount to secure the $200k commit. Details:
- Proposed discount tier: 18% off list for the first 12 months
- One-time onboarding credit: $30,000 (applied to first invoice)
- Contingency: if Quanta increases to a $300k commit within 60 days, discount can be increased to 22% and credit to $50,000

Ben / Marissa — I have attached the pricing worksheet (Pricing_worksheet_QH_v2.pdf). Can you review and confirm if we can approve the 18% / $30k credit at the AE/manager level, or whether we need an exec OK? If an exec signoff is required, can we target approvals by EOD 2026-05-18 to keep the procurement timeline intact?

Next steps (from call):
- Sarah to confirm legal contact and when the security questionnaire will be returned (Sarah)
- Priyom to schedule POC kickoff (Priyom)
- Ben to prepare redlines template and run contracting checklist (Ben)

Thanks — attaching the draft action plan and pricing worksheet for easy reference.

Attachment: QuantaHealth_ActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Pricing_worksheet_QH_v2.pdf (pdf)

Cheers,

jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Forwarded message follows.
